text: Initial access: Office applications launching command shells or script interpreters.
Credential access: LSASS memory dumping or password extraction.
Defense evasion: Disabling auditing, stopping antivirus, or clearing logs.
Persistence: Registry run-key changes or suspicious scheduled tasks.
LOLBins: Obfuscated PowerShell or certutil downloads.
Lateral movement: Suspicious RDP or WMI remote execution.
Command and control: Unexpected outbound network connections.
Data exfiltration preparation: Archiving sensitive directories.
Privilege escalation: Service manipulation, DLL hijacking, or process injection.
Ransomware: Mass file modifications, encryption activity, or shadow-copy deletion.
